description: Check that a scene's signal connections still point at methods that exist. Returns: per-scene problems - missing handler methods, targets with no script, and connections aimed at nodes that are not in the scene. WHEN TO CALL: after editing a .tscn, or after renaming or removing a signal handler in GDScript. Connections are stored as unvalidated STRINGS, so a stale one produces no compile error and fails only when the signal fires at runtime. Handler existence is checked against the LSP's parse of the attached script.
name: scene_validate
